name: @apex-log-insights/cli
description: CLI for viewing Salesforce Apex debug logs in the browser.
author: Gautam Kolan

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && pnpm build:worker && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/bin.js && node --import tsx ../../scripts/copy-cli-viewer.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:worker
